r: AP govt (CM Jagan Mohan Reddy, 26 Sep 2019) decided to tax **industrial houses** to check pollution, with a ban on single-use plastic
**Implements environmental laws and rules in AP**; siting guidelines; SOPs for effluents, marine outfalls, hazardous waste; computerised **risk-based** inspections
AP's only Blue Flag beach (2020); status restored **March 2025**
Demonstration centre for alternative agriculture and sustainability, run with volunteers
**1991**, Government of India (environment ministry, with BIS standards)
Voluntary label for environment-friendly consumer products
Voluntary third-party certification for sustainable forestry and agroforestry
Soaps and detergents, paper, plastics, **cosmetics, aerosols**
July 2019 – MoEFCC shortlisted **12 beaches** to apply (incl. Rushikonda, AP); 8 recommended in 2020 and certified; BEAMS programme
Rules notified **Oct 2023**; administrator **ICFRE**; eight activities, **tree plantation** first operational
Indigenous purifier for traffic junctions – filters PM and removes gases (NO2, SO2, CO, O3) with activated carbon
**CSIR-NEERI** with IIT Bombay, DST-funded – **Ministry of Science and Technology**
Delhi govt, **7 July 2022** (Environment Minister Gopal Rai); citizen-volunteer campaign; registration by missed call
NCAP, CAQM, GRAP, **BS-VI from 1 April 2020**; **NAAQS for 12 pollutants**
Decriminalised minor offences under Air Act and EP Act – jail replaced by monetary penalties
SC upheld PCB power under **Sec 33A Water Act** and **Sec 31A Air Act**
Penalties go to the Fund under **Sec 16 EPA**; shared **75% States/UTs : 25% Centre**; audited by **CAG**

3.x: Revised industry categories: new **Blue** category (e.g. compressed biogas); the compulsory **33% green belt** replaced by pollution-potential norms.

**Firecracker safety:** **PESO** (Petroleum and Explosives Safety Organisation, Commerce and Industry Ministry) certifies firecrackers and enforces safety standards under the **Explosives Act, 1884**.

Farm solar pumps and solar plants

PM Surya Ghar Muft Bijli Yojana
Rooftop solar for **1 crore** homes; up to **300 units** free a month
Renewables, efficient kilns, **green cement (Portland limestone cement)**
Captures CO2 from **point sources** (e.g. cement plants); largely at research stage
Microbes/plants clean water and soil; **cost-effective but slower**
DST approved five CCUS test beds (May 2025)
Proposed **₹20,000 crore** (over five years) for CCUS
